models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description:
Registered customer accounts with email and password credentials, account security status, and lifecycle control for login access.

This table is the canonical identity record for the customer actor. It owns authentication credentials and account-level status only; profile data, sessions, password resets, and email verification records are handled in separate tables. Order history, reviews, and other marketplace records reference this model indirectly and are preserved independently when the customer account is deleted.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address used for customer login and account identity.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password used for authentication.

plainFields.name: account_status
plainFields.description: Customer account state used to control login and administrative restrictions, such as active, banned, or deleted.

plainFields.name: banned_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account was banned, if applicable.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was soft-deleted, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description:
Stores login sessions for customer accounts so authenticated access can be tracked, expired, and revoked securely.

Each row represents one customer session created during login and supports auditability for authentication events. The session belongs to exactly one customer and records connection context plus expiration metadata for secure session management.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used when the customer session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current request URL or page context associated with the session creation event.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL recorded at session creation time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Time when the session becomes invalid and can no longer be used.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_password_resets
models.description:
Stores password reset tokens issued to a customer for account recovery and password change flows.

Each record belongs to exactly one customer and is used to validate a temporary reset operation within a limited time window. The table keeps only the security token state and audit timestamps, while the customer account remains in {@link shopping_mall_customers}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer account that requested the password reset token. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secret reset token issued for a single password recovery attempt.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Time when the reset token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Time when the reset token was consumed, if it has already been used.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when the reset token record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Time when the reset token record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Time when the reset token record was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_email_verifications
models.description:
Stores email verification tokens for customer registration confirmation and email ownership validation.

Each record represents a single verification attempt issued to a customer account. The table supports the account registration flow, email revalidation, and secure token expiration handling while keeping verification history separate from the customer identity record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure verification token used to confirm the customer's email ownership.

plainFields.name: sent_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification email was issued to the customer.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the email was successfully verified. Null until verification completes.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token expires and can no longer be used.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification record was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Registered seller accounts with email/password credentials, approval workflow state, and account security status.

This table is the canonical identity record for seller actors in the marketplace. It stores only the intrinsic account data needed for authentication and lifecycle control, while seller profile data, sessions, password resets, email verification, and approval review history are managed in separate child tables.

The seller account can be used for login, approval gating, and administrative moderation. Historical and dependent business artifacts are preserved elsewhere so the account record remains normalized and stable over time.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller login email address used for authentication and account lookup.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed seller password used for authentication.

plainFields.name: approval_status
plainFields.description: Current administrative approval state for the seller account, such as pending, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided when the seller account is rejected by an administrator.

plainFields.name: account_status
plainFields.description: Security and access status of the seller account, such as active, suspended, or banned.

plainFields.name: approved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was approved, if approval has occurred.

plainFields.name: rejected_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was rejected, if rejection has occurred.

plainFields.name: suspended_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was suspended, if the account is currently or previously suspended.

plainFields.name: banned_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was banned, if the account is currently or previously banned.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful seller login.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for seller login sessions, including refresh token tracking and revocation support. Each record belongs to exactly one {@link shopping_mall_sellers} account and stores the connection context needed to audit and manage seller authentication sessions.

This table is a session-level audit entity rather than business data. It supports login persistence, revocation, and security review for seller accounts while keeping the seller identity in the parent actor table.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address recorded when the seller session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current page or origin URL associated with the seller session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL recorded for the seller session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller session expires and becomes invalid.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_password_resets
models.description: Stores password reset tokens issued for {@link shopping_mall_sellers} during account recovery and password change flows. Each record represents one reset request, including the token used to verify the request, its expiration, and whether it has already been consumed. This table is a seller-owned authentication support entity and is managed as part of the seller account lifecycle.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owning seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure password reset token used to validate the recovery request.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reset token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was consumed, if it has already been used.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_email_verifications
models.description:
Stores email verification tokens issued for seller registration confirmation and seller email ownership validation. Each record belongs to one seller account and tracks the token lifecycle so verification attempts can be confirmed, expired, or invalidated without mixing credential data into the seller identity table.

This table supports seller onboarding and email re-verification flows. It preserves a clean, normalized history of verification attempts while referencing {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} for ownership.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller account that owns this email verification token. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique email verification token used to confirm the seller's email address.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Time when this verification token expires and can no longer be used.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Time when the seller email address was successfully verified. Null until verification is completed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for invalidated verification records.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrators
models.description:
Registered administrator accounts with email and password credentials, role grade, and account security state. This table is the canonical identity record for platform administrators, supporting login, grade-based authorization, and account-level suspension or ban status.

Administrator session tracking, password recovery, and governance request workflows are stored in separate tables. This separation keeps the actor record focused on authentication and authorization while preserving normalization and clear ownership boundaries.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator login email address used for authentication and account lookup.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password used for administrator authentication.

plainFields.name: grade
plainFields.description: Administrator privilege level. Regular administrators can manage platform operations, while super administrators can also promote or demote administrator grades.

plainFields.name: account_status
plainFields.description: Security state of the administrator account, such as active, suspended, or banned, used to control login access.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for administrator login sessions, including refresh token tracking and revocation support.

This table stores one authentication session per administrator login event and records the connection context needed for security auditing, logout, and session expiration handling. It belongs to {@link shopping_mall_administrators} through a child-to-parent relationship and does not contain business domain data.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged administrator's {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used when the administrator session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current request URL or session entry point recorded at login time.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL recorded with the administrator session context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp used to revoke or invalidate the login session.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for administrator account recovery and password change flows. Each record belongs to one administrator account and stores the recovery token lifecycle so password reset requests can be validated, expired, and audited securely.

This table is a child of {@link shopping_mall_administrators} and does not store any reusable identity data. It exists only to support secure password reset operations for administrator accounts.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator account that owns this password reset token. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secret password reset token used to authorize an administrator password recovery or change request.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Time when this password reset token becomes invalid and can no longer be used.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Time when the token was successfully consumed for a password reset request. Null until the token is used.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when this password reset token record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Time when this password reset token record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Time when this token record was soft deleted, if ever removed from active use.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description:
Stores each customer’s saved product interests for later reference. Each record links one customer to one product so wishlist state stays normalized and product-level rather than variant-level.

The wishlist is customer-owned pre-purchase intent data and is kept separate from the cart because it does not represent a checkout-ready selection. It supports browsing and later recall of products a customer wants to revisit, while preserving referential integrity to {@link shopping_mall_customers.id} and {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this wishlist entry. References {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product saved by the customer for later reference. References {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist entry was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description:
Stores each customer's active pre-order basket and checkout preparation state. The cart is a customer-owned container for selected variant items and is separate from completed orders.

Each customer has at most one active cart, and the cart itself does not store line items, totals, or product details. Those belong to {@link shopping_mall_cart_items} and are managed as child records so the cart remains normalized and focused on ownership and lifecycle only.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Owning customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}. Each customer can have only one active cart.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart record was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description:
Stores the individual product-variant lines that belong to a customer's cart. Each record represents one selected variant with its chosen quantity, supporting editable pre-order shopping state before checkout.

The table references the owning {@link shopping_mall_carts} record and the selected {@link shopping_mall_product_variants} record, but it does not duplicate product details such as name, price, seller, or options. Those values are resolved through the related variant and product tables so the cart remains normalized and current while the customer is still shopping.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Owning cart's {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Selected product variant's {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of the selected product variant currently intended for purchase.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was soft deleted, if removed from the cart history.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description: Top-level purchase records for a customer's successful checkout. This table stores the committed order header, including the order number, owning customer, monetary totals, lifecycle status, and preserved shipping destination context used for order history, seller fulfillment, and legal record keeping. It intentionally does not store line items or item snapshots, which are handled by {@link shopping_mall_order_items} and related snapshot tables in other schema calls.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Owning customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}. The order remains associated with the purchaser for history, support, and dispute resolution.

foreignFields.name: shipping_address_id
foreignFields.description: Selected shipping address's {@link shopping_mall_shipping_addresses.id} used for this order at checkout time. The reference supports fulfillment context while preserving the customer's address ownership model.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Human-readable order identifier shown to customers, sellers, and administrators. This value is generated for external reference and support workflows.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Overall order lifecycle state derived from its items and fulfillment progress. Expected business states include paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded, and partially_completed.

plainFields.name: subtotal_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount before shipping fees, discounts, and other adjustments. This reflects the monetary value of the purchased items at checkout time.

plainFields.name: shipping_fee_amount
plainFields.description: Shipping charge applied to the order at checkout time. Stored separately from item totals to preserve the committed transaction amount.

plainFields.name: discount_amount
plainFields.description: Total discount applied to the order at checkout time. This is stored as a positive amount representing the reduction from the gross total.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Final amount charged for the order after applying shipping fees and discounts. This is the authoritative order total used for history and reporting.

plainFields.name: placed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the checkout was successfully completed and the order was created.

plainFields.name: paid_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when payment was successfully confirmed for the order. Nullable only if the order can exist before payment confirmation in the integration flow.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for administrative or retention workflows when an order record is logically removed from active views while historical preservation remains possible.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description: Purchased product-variant line items within an order. Each record represents one specific variant purchase, the purchased quantity, and the current fulfillment state for that line. The table keeps only the live transactional references and item lifecycle fields; preserved purchase-state details such as product, variant, and seller profile snapshots are stored in the dedicated snapshot table {@link shopping_mall_order_item_snapshots}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged order's {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Purchased variant's {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units purchased for this variant in the order line.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current fulfillment state of the order item. Expected values are paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, or refunded.

plainFields.name: shipped_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this item was marked shipped through a shipment record.

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this item was marked delivered or auto-completed as delivered.

plainFields.name: cancelled_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this item was cancelled.

plainFields.name: refunded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this item was refunded.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for administrative or lifecycle archiving use.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipments
models.description:
Seller-specific fulfillment groups for an order, including carrier and tracking details for the order items shipped together.

Each shipment belongs to exactly one order and one seller, and is used to group one or more order items that are dispatched together under the same tracking context. The table stores the shipment lifecycle state and delivery timestamps so customers, sellers, and administrators can follow fulfillment progress without duplicating order item data.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged order's {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description: Name of the shipping carrier used for this shipment.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Tracking number or code assigned by the carrier for package lookup.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current shipment state such as created, shipped, delivered, or cancelled, used to reflect fulfillment progress.

plainFields.name: shipped_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was handed over to the carrier or marked as shipped.

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was confirmed delivered.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for shipment records that are no longer active.

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_requests
models.description: Stores a customer's cancellation request for a single order item. The record keeps the current cancellation workflow state and the reason submitted by the customer so sellers and administrators can review active requests while the immutable decision history is preserved in {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Order item that this cancellation request belongs to. References {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer-provided reason for requesting cancellation of the order item.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current cancellation request status used to track the seller review lifecycle.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was soft deleted, if ever removed from active views.

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots
models.description:
Stores immutable historical snapshots of customer cancellation requests for order items. Each record preserves the request state at the moment of change, including the parent request reference, request status, reason, and seller response context so the full cancellation history can be reviewed later for audit and dispute resolution.

This table is append-only and represents a point-in-time record rather than the live request. It exists to preserve the evolving state of {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_requests} even after the active request changes or is resolved.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_request_id
foreignFields.description: Parent cancellation request whose state is preserved in this snapshot. References {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_requests.id}.

plainFields.name: request_status
plainFields.description: Cancellation request status at the time this snapshot was created, such as pending, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer-provided reason captured from the cancellation request at the time of snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: seller_response
plainFields.description: Seller decision or response text preserved from the request state when applicable. This records the review outcome context at the moment of change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this immutable snapshot record was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_requests
models.description:
Stores customer refund requests for individual delivered order items, including the refund reason and current request status.

Each record belongs to one purchased order item and one customer, and it represents the active refund claim that sellers review. Historical changes to the request are preserved separately in {@link shopping_mall_refund_request_snapshots}, so this table only keeps the current live state needed for workflows and moderation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Refund-requested order item's {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Requesting customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer-provided reason for requesting the refund.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current workflow status of the refund request, such as pending, approved, rejected, or cancelled.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request was last reviewed by the seller or administrator.

plainFields.name: reviewed_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided when the request was approved or rejected.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp used to preserve request history while hiding inactive records.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable point-in-time snapshots of refund request state changes. Each record preserves the refund request's status, reason, and response context at the moment a change was recorded so later audits and dispute reviews can reconstruct the full history of the request.

This table is append-only and belongs to {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests}. It stores historical state only and must not be edited in place. The parent refund request remains the live record, while this table preserves each version of that record over time.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_id
foreignFields.description: Parent refund request's {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests.id} whose historical state is being preserved in this snapshot.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Refund request status captured at the time this snapshot was created, such as pending, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Refund reason text preserved from the refund request at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: response_message
plainFields.description: Seller or administrator response message preserved for audit and dispute review when the request was decided.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this historical snapshot row was recorded.

models.name: shopping_mall_reviews
models.description:
Stores each customer review for a purchased product and order item.

The table keeps the active review record with its rating, optional text content, and visibility state for soft deletion. It is linked to the customer who wrote the review, the purchased product, and the corresponding order item so review eligibility and ownership can be validated without storing redundant product or seller data. Historical edits and deleted-state history are preserved in {@link shopping_mall_review_snapshots}, while this table represents the current review state used for product detail pages, moderation, and newest-first review listing.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Authoring customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reviewed product's {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Purchased order item's {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id} that qualified the review.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Star rating from 1 to 5 given by the customer.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Optional review body written by the customer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was soft deleted, if it has been removed from active display.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable historical snapshots of customer reviews. Each record preserves the state of a review at a specific moment so edits and deletions can be audited, moderated, and displayed for dispute resolution even after the active review changes.

This table belongs to {@link shopping_mall_reviews} as append-only history and must never be used as the live review record. It stores the review content and metadata that can change over time, while the current review state remains in the parent review table.

foreignFields.name: review_id
foreignFields.description: Historical snapshot of {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the review star rating at the time this version was recorded.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the review text content at the time this version was recorded.

plainFields.name: is_deleted
plainFields.description: Whether the review was marked deleted at the time this snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was created.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was logically deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests
models.description:
Stores seller registration approval requests submitted for administrative review. Each record represents one seller's current application state, including the applicant reference, the moderation status, and any rejection reason, while the immutable review history is stored separately in {@link shopping_mall_seller_approval_request_reviews}.

This table is the canonical request header for seller onboarding moderation. It supports queue browsing, status tracking, and lifecycle management for pending, approved, and rejected applications without duplicating per-review audit records.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Applicant seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current moderation status of the seller approval request, such as pending, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided when the request is rejected. Null while the request is pending or approved.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the approval request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the approval request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the approval request was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_approval_request_reviews
models.description:
Stores immutable review decisions for seller approval requests. Each row records one administrative review event, including the reviewing administrator, the decision outcome, and the time the decision was made.

This table functions as a historical audit trail for {@link shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests} and preserves every review action independently so the approval process can be traced after the current request state changes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_approval_request_id
foreignFields.description: Seller approval request being reviewed. References {@link shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who performed the review decision. References {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: decision
plainFields.description: Review outcome for the seller approval request, such as approved or rejected.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review decision was made.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for audit-preserving removal of the active row, if ever used.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_requests
models.description:
Administrator application requests submitted for super-administrator review. This table stores the canonical request record, the applicant type-specific linkage, the submitted reason, and the current request status so the platform can manage pending applications, approvals, and rejections as independent business records.

The request row is the current-state entity for the application lifecycle. Applicant ownership must be modeled through a normalized subtype structure instead of multiple nullable actor foreign keys, while decision history is stored separately in {@link shopping_mall_administrator_request_reviews}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by the applicant for becoming an administrator.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current application status, such as pending, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: rejected_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided when the request is rejected. Nullable because it exists only for rejected applications.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request was soft-deleted, if ever removed from active use.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_request_reviews
models.description:
Stores the immutable review history for administrator application requests. Each row records a super administrator's decision on a specific administrator request, including whether it was approved or rejected and when the decision was made.

This table is append-only and is used for auditability, dispute review, and governance traceability. It references {@link shopping_mall_administrator_requests.id} for the request under review and {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id} for the reviewing super administrator.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_administrator_request_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator application request being reviewed. References {@link shopping_mall_administrator_requests.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Super administrator who performed the review decision. References {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: decision
plainFields.description: Review decision outcome for the administrator application request. Expected values are approve or reject.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review decision was recorded.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_grade_histories
models.description:
Immutable audit history for administrator grade changes, including promotions and demotions between regular administrator and super administrator.

Each record preserves who was affected, who performed the change, what the previous grade was, what the new grade became, and when the change occurred. This supports accountability, governance review, and historical reconstruction of administrator privilege changes through {@link shopping_mall_administrators}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator whose grade changed. References {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

foreignFields.name: performed_by_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who performed the grade change. References {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: previous_grade
plainFields.description: Administrator grade before the change. Expected values are the platform's administrator grades, such as regular administrator or super administrator.

plainFields.name: new_grade
plainFields.description: Administrator grade after the change. Expected values are the platform's administrator grades, such as regular administrator or super administrator.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Human-readable reason or note explaining why the administrator grade was changed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this grade change record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this grade change record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. This table is an audit history record and is expected to remain retained, so this value is normally unused.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_request_applicant_customers
models.description:
Normalized applicant link table for administrator requests submitted by customers. Each record connects one administrator request to the customer who submitted it, allowing the main administrator request table to remain free of multiple nullable actor foreign keys.

This table is a dependent subtype record used only for customer-originated administrator applications. It preserves referential integrity between {@link shopping_mall_administrator_requests} and {@link shopping_mall_customers} while keeping the ownership model fully normalized.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_administrator_request_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator request being submitted by the customer. {@link shopping_mall_administrator_requests.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who submitted the administrator request. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the applicant link record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the applicant link record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the applicant link record was soft deleted, if ever removed from active use.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_request_applicant_sellers
models.description:
Normalized applicant link table for administrator requests submitted by sellers. This table stores which seller account is associated with a given administrator request, allowing the main administrator request record to remain free of multiple nullable actor foreign keys.

The record exists only to connect {@link shopping_mall_administrator_requests} with {@link shopping_mall_sellers} in a 1:1 applicant structure for seller-submitted administrator applications. It supports the governance workflow while keeping the request entity normalized and unambiguous.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_administrator_request_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced administrator request {@link shopping_mall_administrator_requests.id} for this seller applicant link.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced seller account {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} that submitted the administrator request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this seller applicant link record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this seller applicant link record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this seller applicant link record was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshots
models.description: Immutable point-in-time snapshots of product state captured whenever a product is edited. This table preserves the product's historical business state for audit, dispute resolution, and change review, including the product identity and the values that were current at the time of capture. Related product image state is preserved through separate normalized snapshot child records rather than an array or JSON field.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product whose state was captured in this snapshot. References {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: snapshot_version
plainFields.description: Monotonic version number of this product snapshot for the related product, used to order historical captures.

plainFields.name: captured_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product state was captured into this immutable snapshot.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: description_text
plainFields.description: Product description at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price of the product at the time of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable point-in-time records of product variant state. This table preserves the exact variant data at the moment a change occurred so historical product listing, pricing, and availability can be reviewed later.

Each record captures the snapshot version of a single product variant, including SKU, option values, price, and stock-related attributes as they existed at that time. These records are append-only audit artifacts and are used for product history, dispute resolution, and restored view generation, without mutating prior versions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced product variant's {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}. Identifies which variant this historical snapshot belongs to.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the variant SKU code at the time the snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: option_values
plainFields.description: Atomic snapshot text of the variant option values at that point in time, such as persisted labels for color and size.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the variant price at the time of change. Preserves the purchasable amount that applied to this version.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the variant stock quantity recorded for historical state inspection.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this immutable snapshot was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_item_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable point-in-time records of purchased order item state. This table preserves the checkout-time business context for {@link shopping_mall_order_items}, including the purchased product, selected variant, seller storefront identity, quantity, and pricing details exactly as they existed when the order was placed.

The record is append-only and serves as an audit artifact for historical review, dispute resolution, and post-purchase integrity checks. It is designed to outlive changes or deletion in the active product, variant, or seller profile tables so that past purchases remain understandable even after the source entities evolve.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Purchased order item's {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id} whose checkout-time state is preserved by this snapshot.

plainFields.name: product_name
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the product name at the time of purchase.

plainFields.name: product_description
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the product description at the time of purchase.

plainFields.name: variant_sku
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the purchased variant SKU code at the time of purchase.

plainFields.name: variant_option_values
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the purchased variant option values as displayed at checkout. This is stored as a normalized textual representation of the historical option combination, not as a structured JSON field.

plainFields.name: seller_shop_name
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the seller storefront name at the time of purchase.

plainFields.name: seller_shop_description
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the seller storefront description at the time of purchase.

plainFields.name: seller_logo_image
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the seller logo image reference at the time of purchase.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of the variant purchased in the order item at the time the snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Unit price charged for the purchased variant at the time of checkout.

plainFields.name: total_price
plainFields.description: Total price for the order item at the time of checkout, derived from quantity and unit price for historical preservation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this historical snapshot record was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_records
models.description:
Running inventory movement history for {@link shopping_mall_product_variants}.

Each record stores a single atomic stock movement event for one product variant, including the signed quantity change, the business reason for the movement, and the event timestamp used to reconstruct current stock. Current stock is calculated from the accumulated movement history rather than stored directly in this table.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced product variant's {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}. This identifies which variant received the stock movement.

plainFields.name: quantity_change
plainFields.description: Signed inventory delta for the movement. Positive values represent stock increases such as restocking or stock restoration, while negative values represent stock decreases such as sales or manual deductions.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Business reason for the inventory movement, such as order deduction, restock, cancellation restoration, refund restoration, or manual adjustment.

plainFields.name: occurred_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory movement actually occurred in business terms. This is used to reconstruct stock history in event order.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for auditing and chronological listing.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp for auditing administrative corrections or system maintenance edits.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for retention-aware cleanup. Inventory history is typically preserved, so this should remain nullable.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshot_images
models.description:
Normalized child records that preserve the image state of a product at the moment a product snapshot was captured. Each row stores exactly one image reference and its display order within the snapshot, allowing the system to reconstruct the full product image set for historical review and dispute resolution.

This table belongs to {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshots} as an immutable audit child and must not store product-level attributes such as name, description, category, or price. It exists only to preserve the snapshot-time image collection in a fully normalized form.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product snapshot's {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshots.id} that owns this captured image state.

plainFields.name: image_uri
plainFields.description: Original image reference captured at the time of the product snapshot.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Zero-based or one-based ordering position of this image within the snapshot, used to reconstruct the historical gallery order.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot-image row was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_profiles
models.description: Stores the public-facing profile information for a customer account, including the display name and phone number used for account and checkout identity. This profile belongs to exactly one customer and is removed when the customer account is deleted.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Owning customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}. Each customer has exactly one profile record.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Customer display name shown in account and customer-facing contexts.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Customer phone number used for contact and delivery-related communication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile record was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipping_addresses
models.description:
Stores one or more shipping addresses owned by a customer profile, including recipient details and full delivery address components.

These addresses are used during checkout and order fulfillment so customers can select a destination without re-entering delivery information. The table is customer-owned, supports a default shipping address, and keeps the address data normalized into atomic fields for reliable editing, listing, and deletion.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Owner customer's {@link shopping_mall_customer_profiles.id}. This address belongs to a single customer profile and is used for checkout and delivery selection.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Name of the person who should receive the shipment at this address.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Contact phone number for the recipient at the delivery destination.

plainFields.name: street_address
plainFields.description: Street line and detailed delivery location information for this shipping address.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City or locality component of the delivery address.

plainFields.name: state_province
plainFields.description: State, province, or region component of the delivery address.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal or ZIP code used for delivery routing.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country component of the delivery address.

plainFields.name: is_default
plainFields.description: Whether this is the customer's default shipping address for checkout convenience.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the address is treated as deleted while preserving history.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_profiles
models.description:
Stores the current public storefront identity for each seller, including the shop name, shop description, and logo image used in customer-facing views.

This table represents the seller's active profile state only. Historical changes are preserved separately in {@link shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots}, so this model contains only the latest editable storefront information and the seller ownership link.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owning seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. Each seller has at most one current storefront profile.

plainFields.name: shop_name
plainFields.description: Public storefront name shown to customers on product pages and seller profile views.

plainFields.name: shop_description
plainFields.description: Public description of the seller's shop and business identity.

plainFields.name: logo_image_url
plainFields.description: URL of the seller's current logo image used in customer-facing views.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this storefront profile record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this storefront profile record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this storefront profile record was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable historical versions of seller storefront profile changes. Each row preserves the seller profile state at a specific point in time so prior shop identity values remain available for audit, dispute review, and change history reconstruction.

This table is a snapshot of {@link shopping_mall_seller_profiles} and stores the captured profile data as it existed when the edit was made. It is append-only in practice and should not be updated after creation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_profile_id
foreignFields.description: The current seller profile whose previous state was captured in this snapshot. References {@link shopping_mall_seller_profiles.id}.

plainFields.name: shop_name
plainFields.description: Captured shop name value at the time this seller profile snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: shop_description
plainFields.description: Captured shop description value at the time this seller profile snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: logo_image_uri
plainFields.description: Captured logo image URI value at the time this seller profile snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this historical snapshot record was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Marketplace product listings created by sellers and shown in catalog browsing, search, category pages, and product detail views.

This table stores the current canonical product record only: title, description, base price, ownership, category assignment, and lifecycle timestamps. Product images, variants, and historical snapshots are modeled in separate tables to preserve normalization and to support immutable history, while this table remains the source of truth for the active listing.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owning seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. Product visibility, editing rights, and deletion rules are based on this ownership relation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned category's {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}. This is optional because products must remain available as uncategorized when a category is deleted or cleared by administrators.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Public product name shown in listings, detail pages, and search results.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Public product description shown on the product detail page. It explains what the product is and helps customers compare listings.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price of the product before variant-specific overrides are considered. This is used for listing display and as the fallback purchasable price when a variant does not define its own price.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was soft-deleted. A null value means the product is active and eligible for listings.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description:
Purchasable product variants for marketplace listings. Each row represents one selectable SKU-level variant that belongs to a product and can be purchased independently when in stock.

This table stores the raw variant identity and commercial state, including the SKU code, optional price override, and current stock quantity. Availability is derived from stock and deletion state rather than stored as a separate calculated field. Structured option values are normalized into a separate child table so that each variant remains 1NF compliant and can support multiple option dimensions such as color and size.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product's {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique stock keeping unit code for this variant.

plainFields.name: override_price
plainFields.description: Optional sale price for this variant when it differs from the product base price.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Current raw stock quantity for this variant. This is the stored inventory state used to determine whether the variant is in stock or out of stock.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the variant is no longer available for new purchase flows but historical references remain valid.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description: Stores ordered image records for a product so each product can have multiple gallery images with a stable display order. The first image is used as the main thumbnail in product listings and detail pages, and all image records belong to {@link shopping_mall_products}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that owns this image record. References {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: image_uri
plainFields.description: Public URI of the product image file used in listings and product detail views.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Zero-based or one-based ordering value used to determine the image sequence for a product gallery; the smallest value is shown first as the thumbnail.

plainFields.name: alt_text
plainFields.description: Optional alternative text for accessibility and image presentation metadata.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this image record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this image record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this image record was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description:
Marketplace product categories used to organize listings across the platform.

Each category stores a human-readable name and description, and may optionally reference a parent category to represent one level of subcategory nesting. Products can point to a category for browsing and filtering, and if a category is removed, products may become uncategorized without losing the product record itself.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Optional parent category for one-level subcategory organization. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category display name used in browsing, filtering, and administration.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Category explanation shown to help users understand the grouping purpose.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was soft deleted, when applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_options
models.description:
Stores one atomic option dimension for a single product variant, such as color or size. This table exists to keep product variant option data normalized and 1NF compliant, with one row per option name and option value.

The records are managed through {@link shopping_mall_product_variants} and should never contain combined option strings, arrays, or JSON payloads. Each row represents a single selectable attribute of the variant and supports clean querying, editing, and snapshot preservation in the product domain.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Related product variant's {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: option_name
plainFields.description: Atomic option dimension name such as color, size, or material.

plainFields.name: option_value
plainFields.description: Atomic option value for the option dimension, such as Red or Large.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for the option row.
